messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — afternoon sprint on keyword + schema for next week's webinar and launch posts. Need internal link plan and redirect list. Who can own canonical mapping? :calendar:
James Patel: I can take canonical mapping. Will draft redirect CSV today. Any priority keywords we should bake in?
Sara Lopez: I'll own schema snippets and structured-data testing. Can we standardize webinar schema across the landing page + blog posts? thinking Event + potential SoftwareApplication for the demo. :nerd_face:
Leo Nguyen: For inbound routing, Product Ops wants gated webinar -> lead scoring tag. Need final CTA paths. Proposed flow: /register -> hubspot form -> redirect to /thank-you. Also need redirect rules for old promo links. Quick redirect sample:```
/webinar-register -> /landing/webinar-q2-2026?utm_campaign=launch 301
/old-launch-blog -> /launch-2026-post-1 301
/launch-post-cta -> /signup 302
```
Maria Chen: Thanks — prioritized KW list for copy: "llm inference platform", "inference cost optimization", "GPU inference hosting". Use those in H1/H2/meta where natural. James, please surface where they map to canonical URLs.
Sara Lopez: I'll drop a minimal JSON-LD for the webinar landing. Plan to share and test it in the thread. Example snippet:```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Live Demo — Q2 Launch",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T17:00:00-07:00",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/landing/webinar-q2-2026" },
  "organizer": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference" }
}
```
Leo Nguyen: Tagging/UTM standards: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=post, utm_campaign=launch-q2. Add hidden form field source=webinar_inbound to help routing rules. Also note any redirect to external partners must preserve utm params.
James Patel: I'll push the redirect CSV to the shared drive (Marketing/SEO/redirects/webinar-launch-1768.csv) and ping eng-ops for Netlify/edge rule implementation. ETA EOD today. @Sara Lopez will you review the JSON-LD after I map canonical URLs?
Sara Lopez: Yes — I will validate with Search Console structured data tester and run local Lighthouse checks. Also adding a short QA checklist: check canonical, test 301s, confirm noindex on staging, run internal-link depth report.
Maria Chen: One more note — avoid changing existing /docs paths; prefer new paths with rel=canonical pointing to main launch page. Keep legacy redirects in place for 90 days then revisit. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled content deploy tomorrow 09:00 PDT — please freeze URL changes after 18:00 today.
